int_name: MARTIN LUTHER KING DR & SWEETBRIAR DR

result.summary: The image shows a well-maintained paved multi-use path separated from a roadway by a metal guardrail in a park-like setting. While the path provides excellent longitudinal separation for pedestrians, there is a complete lack of visible crossing infrastructure, such as marked crosswalks or pedestrian signals, at the signalized intersection.

hazards.name: Lack of marked crossing
hazards.description: There is no designated or marked crosswalk at this signalized intersection, forcing pedestrians to cross an unmarked roadway.
hazards.location_in_image: Intersection area near the traffic signal pole

hazards.name: Missing pedestrian signalization
hazards.description: The traffic signal pole lacks a pedestrian signal head, meaning pedestrians have no dedicated phase or indication of when it is safe to cross.
hazards.location_in_image: Traffic signal pole on the left

hazards.name: Physical barrier to crossing
hazards.description: The continuous guardrail acts as a physical barrier for pedestrians attempting to access the roadway from the path to cross.
hazards.location_in_image: Running horizontally across the middle of the image

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk
interventions.description: Install a continental-style marked crosswalk to clearly define the pedestrian right-of-way across the intersection.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Signal Heads
interventions.description: Add pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to the existing traffic signal infrastructure.

interventions.title: ADA Compliant Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install curb ramps with detectable warning surfaces to provide an accessible transition between the path and the roadway.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment features a paved multi-use path separated from a two-lane roadway by a grass buffer. A signalized zebra crosswalk is provided, but the lack of physical traffic calming and potential sightline obstructions from roadside vegetation may impact safety on this straight stretch of road.

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: Dense trees and bushes on the left side of the road may hide pedestrians from the view of approaching motorists.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the road near the crosswalk

hazards.name: Lack of Traffic Calming
hazards.description: The straight, wide roadway design without physical speed reduction measures may encourage high vehicle speeds near the crossing.
hazards.location_in_image: Main roadway approaching the crosswalk

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions at the crosswalk to increase pedestrian visibility and reduce the crossing distance.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Add a raised median island to provide a safe waiting area for pedestrians and simplify the crossing task.

interventions.title: Vegetation Management
interventions.description: Trim or remove roadside vegetation near the crossing to improve sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.

result.summary: The environment is extremely hostile to pedestrians, featuring a complete lack of sidewalks, crosswalks, or any dedicated pedestrian infrastructure. The wide, unmarked roadway and the presence of an underpass create a high-speed vehicular environment with significant sightline obstructions.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Infrastructure
hazards.description: There are no sidewalks or designated walking paths, forcing pedestrians to walk on the roadway or unpaved grass.
hazards.location_in_image: Entire foreground and sides of the road

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Underpass
hazards.description: The bridge structure limits sightlines for both drivers and pedestrians, making it difficult to see oncoming traffic through the tunnel.
hazards.location_in_image: Center of image at the bridge opening

hazards.name: Wide Unmarked Roadway
hazards.description: The lack of lane markings and the extreme width of the asphalt encourage high vehicle speeds and create long, unprotected crossing distances.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground roadway

interventions.title: Sidewalk Installation
interventions.description: Construct paved sidewalks on both sides of the roadway to provide physical separation between pedestrians and vehicles.

interventions.title: Marked Crosswalks and Signage
interventions.description: Install high-visibility marked crosswalks and pedestrian crossing warning signs to designate safe crossing points.

interventions.title: Lane Narrowing and Markings
interventions.description: Apply lane markings to define travel lanes and narrow the perceived roadway width to naturally reduce vehicle speeds.

result.summary: The image depicts a signalized intersection on a three-lane roadway that lacks essential pedestrian infrastructure, including marked crosswalks and pedestrian signals. While a well-maintained sidewalk is present on one side, the overall design prioritizes vehicular movement, leaving pedestrians exposed during long crossing distances without designated protection.

hazards.name: Absence of Marked Crosswalks
hazards.description: No painted markings exist to guide pedestrians or alert drivers to potential crossing activity at this signalized junction.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the main roadway at the intersection

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: The intersection lacks walk/don't-walk signals, forcing pedestrians to interpret vehicular lights which may not provide sufficient crossing time.
hazards.location_in_image: Intersection corners

hazards.name: Missing Curb Ramps
hazards.description: There are no sloped transitions between the sidewalk and the street, creating a barrier for people with disabilities or strollers.
hazards.location_in_image: Edge of the sidewalk on the right

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk Markings
interventions.description: Install ladder or zebra-style crosswalks to clearly define the pedestrian path and increase driver yielding rates.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Signal Heads
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signals with countdown timers to ensure safe and predictable crossing intervals.

interventions.title: ADA-Compliant Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Construct ramps with truncated domes to provide an accessible path of travel across the intersection.
